# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

Galactic Stays is an educational project. We welcome people of all backgrounds and experience levels and aim to make participation respectful and free from harassment.

## Our standards

- Be kind, patient, and respectful, especially when helping someone learn.
- Respect different viewpoints and experiences.
- Give and accept constructive feedback, focusing on ideas and code.
- Harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized behavior, and personal attacks are unacceptable.
- Do not share anyone's private information without their permission.

## Scope

These rules apply to everyone, including the maintainer, in repository issues, pull requests, and other project spaces.

## Reporting

For concerns you can safely discuss publicly, [open a conduct report](https://github.com/vontanne/galactic-stays/issues/new?template=conduct_report.md) with a brief description and relevant links. Issues are public: do not include private information or sensitive details.

For serious abuse, harassment, or concerns involving the maintainer, [report the user or content directly to GitHub Support](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam). You do not need to open a public issue first. GitHub handles these reports under its own community guidelines.

## Enforcement

The maintainer is responsible for enforcing these rules and reviewing concerns raised in this project fairly. Depending on the severity and repetition of the behavior, responses may include a warning, removal of inappropriate content, or restrictions on participation.

Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) for this educational project.
